cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a researcher and lecturer specializing in natural language processing, evaluation metrics and trustworthy AI. Over the past years I have led a department, co‑founded a technology centre and contributed to two patents. My recent work on LLM‑as‑a‑judge and hybrid metrics for Turkish summarisation required designing custom loss functions and extensive experimentation with transformer models, which aligns with the need to create advanced neural architectures.

At Toros University I coordinated international collaborations and managed research projects that produced several conference papers and patent drafts. This experience matches the collaborative and publication‑focused environment of the Visual Computing Group.

While my background is rooted in NLP, the core skills, deep learning model design, Python programming, and rigorous evaluation, are transferable to graphics and video processing. I am eager to apply my expertise in model development and research methodology to the challenges of real‑time rendering and streaming.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my research experience and leadership can contribute to Sony Interactive Entertainment's visual computing goals.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
